title: Pangkah!
subject: a 19-year-old at a gasing pangkah (striking-top) contest at the Gelanggang Seni in Kota Bharu, Kelantan, who keeps knocking his uncles' tops out of the ring, talks trash between throws, and leaves his own top spinning longer than the emcee's patience lasts
caption: Brazilian funk phonk in the funk mandelão style, rapped in Malay. A tamborzão drum pattern with a booming kick, a hard clap-snare and tumbling hand-drum fills; a distorted sub-bass punching on the off-beats; a detuned phonk cowbell playing a short repeating melody; brass-synth stabs on the downbeat of each hook. Loud, dry and compressed mix, bass and cowbell forward, shouts spread wide. Male rapper-chanter in a mid register, punchy half-rapped verses with a grin in the voice, a crew of men shouting the hook back. 130 BPM, F minor. Cocky, cheeky and loud, a whole gelanggang's grudging respect. No trap hi-hat rolls, no boom-bap beat, no autotune, no sung pop chorus, no reggaeton dembow, no EDM build-up.
lyrics:
[Intro - cowbell melody and sub-bass hits]

[Verse 1]
Gelanggang Seni Kota Bharu, petang Sabtu
Pak Su, Pak Lang, Pak Ngah datang bawa gasing
Aku baru sembilan belas, tali lilit tangan
Semua gelak, "Budak ni, pergi main guli dulu"

[Pre-Chorus]
Tali tarik ketat, kaki buka luas
Kira satu, dua, aku lepaskan

[Chorus - lead rapper, crew shouting 'Pangkah!' back]
Pangkah! Gasing Pak Su melambung keluar
Pangkah! Pak Lang garu kepala
Gasing aku pusing lagi, tak reti berhenti
Pangkah! Siapa lagi nak cuba?

[Verse 2]
Pak Ngah lap gasing kayu merbau dia
"Gasing ni lagi tua dari kau, jaga sikit"
Aku cakap, "Pak Ngah, gasing tua cepat penat"
Satu pangkah, bunyi tok, satu gelanggang terdiam

[Chorus - lead rapper, crew shouting 'Pangkah!' back]
Pangkah! Gasing Pak Ngah tercampak keluar
Pangkah! Pak Ngah buat-buat tak nampak
Gasing aku pusing lagi, tak reti berhenti
Pangkah! Siapa lagi nak cuba?

[Bridge - cowbell and claps only]
MC tengok jam, "Adik, angkat la gasing tu"
Dua puluh minit, gasing aku masih berdengung

[Chorus - lead rapper, crew shouting 'Pangkah!' back]
Pangkah! Tahun depan Pak Su bawa geng
Pangkah! Pak Lang dah mula berlatih
Gasing aku pusing lagi, MC dah balik rumah
Pangkah! Siapa lagi nak cuba?

[Outro - crowd shouts and cowbell]
